title: JetBrains task detail shows any latest check as "Reported check passed", even a run the delivery policy does not count
description:
Found by the Wave 1 integration gate (task-808869c5, client-contract check). deliveryProjection serves latestCheckRun as {command, exitCode} of the LAST run recorded on the current candidate. It carries no `source`, and it does not say whether the run is the required gate. delivery/policy.ts counts only runner-observed exit-0 runs of the trimmed gate command.

So the detail view can read "Reported check passed - exit code 0" for an agent-reported run while qa_approve refuses required-check:<gate>. It can also show a later failing non-gate run although the gate passed. The label honestly says "Reported", but nothing tells the reader whether the policy counts that run.
definitionOfDone: The daemon projection serves the run's source and whether delivery/policy.ts counts it for the required check (or the required-check status itself), with a daemon test
JetBrains parses and renders it, pinned by a headless presentation test, and an agent-reported or non-gate pass never reads as a satisfied required check
VS Code keeps ignoring the field without error (npm test + compile)
